headline: PHI @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PHI 4.25 at PIT 3.45, with a projected total of 7.71. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PHI moved +0.46 runs while PIT moved -0.45, changing the projected margin by +0.91 runs. NRFI probability rose +22.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Paul Skenes has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Marsh, Kyle Schwarber, Konnor Griffin, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Adolis García because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
